selected.item: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (claude-sonnet-4-6): Anthropic's most capable Sonnet model yet, with a 1M token context window in beta. Full upgrade across coding, computer use, long-context reasoning, agent planning, knowledge work, and design. Pricing unchanged from Sonnet 4.5, starting at $3/$15 per million tokens. Now the default model in claude.ai and Claude Cowork on Free and Pro plans. Available on all Claude plans, Claude Cowork, Claude Code, the API, and all major cloud platforms. Supports adaptive thinking and extended thinking, plus context compaction in beta. Anthropic's early testing: users preferred Sonnet 4.6 over Sonnet 4.5 roughly 70% of the time, and over Opus 4.5 59% of the time (Anthropic's own claims, not independent verification).

selected.item: GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst (gpt-image-2.6-sunburst) and GPT-Image-2.6 Flare (gpt-image-2.6-flare) released for image generation and editing, with adjustable complexity, SVG generation, and animated GIF generation. Markup-guided editing added for supported GPT Image 2.5 and 2.6 models. Endpoints v1/images/generations and v1/images/edits. Pricing (both models): text input $5.00, cached input $1.25, image input $8.00, cached image input $2.00, image output $30.00 per 1M tokens.

selected.item: Inkling 2 Small: second-generation Mixture-of-Experts model with 594B total parameters and 17B active per token, supporting image inputs and variable effort. Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score of 31 (vendor-reported). Initially available through Tinker with closed weights; the lab intends to make the full weights available under an Apache 2.0 license next week after the completion of external safety testing and red-teaming. Try it on Tinker Playground; fine-tuning and sampling on Tinker.

Use POST /v1beta/voices with gemini-3.8-flash-tts (or remix interactively in Google AI Studio) to generate a voice_... ID, then synthesize speech with Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS or Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS.
